title: Explosion Logger
description: Logs Minecraft explosions and instantly sends detailed alerts to Discord through webhooks, helping server owners monitor TNT, griefing, and explosive activity in real time.
body:
ExplosionLogger is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin designed to monitor and log explosion activity in real time. The plugin tracks explosions caused by TNT, creepers, beds, respawn anchors, and other explosive sources, then instantly sends detailed reports to your Discord server using webhooks.

Perfect for SMP, factions, anarchy, and survival servers, ExplosionLogger helps administrators and moderators quickly detect griefing, raids, and suspicious activity without constantly checking console logs.

**Features**

* Real-time Discord webhook logging
* Logs TNT, creeper, and other explosions
* Lightweight and optimized performance
* Easy configuration
* Useful for moderation and anti-grief monitoring
* Supports modern Discord embeds
* Simple setup and integration

**Use Cases**

* Detect base raids instantly
* Monitor player griefing
* Keep staff informed through Discord
* Track explosion activity across your server

**Configuration**

Simply add your Discord webhook URL in the config file, reload the plugin, and ExplosionLogger will begin reporting explosion events automatically.

**Compatibility**

* Minecraft Java Edition
* Bukkit / Spigot / Paper based servers
